learner_audit.scope: Read-only source and production audit. No production mutations, GPU work, service changes or writable ReplayStore initialization. Diagnostic JSON is local temporary output.

checkpoint_reverification.interpretation: Standalone warm read+hash timings extrapolated to recorded iterations, not direct production profiling and not physical disk-byte measurement. Extra refresh-only iterations omitted. Removing overhead does not by itself authorize extra training at fixed UTD.
checkpoint_reverification.minimal_change: Learner-scoped successful-verification cache invalidated by pointer, resolved manifest and checkpoint identity/signature changes; include dev/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns, verify before/after stat stability, never cache failures; fully verify before loading changed weights. Preserve promotion/governor semantics.

replay_scanning.cold_correction: CPU profile identified 4.327 seconds of cached-topology construction in standalone process. Production topologies already warm. Do not cite 4.66 seconds as steady selection cost.
replay_scanning.interpretation: About two sweeps per no-credit/consumption iteration except boundaries. Repeated freshness selection then actual pinned selection adds roughly 1.2 seconds every 60 seconds. Actual pinning path holds write transaction during selection; lock duration not directly measured.
replay_scanning.minimal_change: Deduplicate checks per outer iteration, validate immutable selected-window paths at bounded cadence while preserving immediate load failures/GC pins and step eligibility boundaries. Reuse a staged successor only with atomic revalidation and pinning; do not simply reuse an unpinned snapshot.

loss_dynamic_indexing.finding: Three validation-only variable-length boolean selections run even with trusted_batch=True; losses run outside compiled model.
loss_dynamic_indexing.candidate: Moved selections into existing validate_targets branch in AST memory only. No source-file changes.
loss_dynamic_indexing.impact: Tiny exact cleanup removes three CUDA dynamic-index synchronization opportunities. GPU timing not measured; smaller system priority than control-loop waste.

evaluation.measurement_reason: no complete 1024-simulation balanced strength measurements for the selected evaluation contract

qualifications: Checkpoint and replay control-loop time estimates multiply separate warm probes by observed events; they are not direct live-process profiles.
Explicit sleep sums are completed wait-event durations; interval boundary differences are small but cannot be made exact from sampled phases.
Arena work saved is calculated from recorded moves and configured per-turn PDA budgets, not measured GPU or whole-machine wall-time savings.
Historical publication callbacks follow durable commits; after-expiry callbacks do not prove every underlying commit was already expired. Exact commit-time count remains unverified.
GPU busy percentages are not achieved FLOP utilization.
At fixed UTD, saved learner overhead can become waiting; more steps or faster kernels do not establish an Elo gain.
